data.gender_notes: Dilp is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dilp is recorded with the meaning “Heart”. Dilp is a Hindu name meaning “Heart”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. in_sanskrit.name: Dilp
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Heart
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dilp एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who has a heart full of love and compassion

in_tamil.name: Dilp
in_tamil.long_meaning: Dilp ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who has a heart full of love and compassion

in_telugu.name: Dilp
in_telugu.long_meaning: Dilp ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who has a heart full of love and compassion

in_marathi.name: Dilp
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dilp हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has a heart full of love and compassion

in_bengali.name: Dilp
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dilp একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has a heart full of love and compassion
